description: Halambage Don Wilson v. V.M. Wilson and Another Halambage Don Wilson v. V.M. Wilson and Another View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Halambage Don Wilson v. V.M. Wilson and Another Halambage Don Wilson v. V.M. Wilson and Another View More
keywords: The Appellant appealed against an order refusing a late amendment to the plaint and simultaneously dismissing his action after the schedule describing the subject matter had been omitted from the second amended plaint. Held - Although the refusal of the amendment was justified due to the Appellant’s delay, the trial judge had no authority to dismiss the action solely on that basis; the dismissal was set aside, the refusal of amendment affirmed, and the case remitted for trial without an order for costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
